title: Yellow Crisp Thai Apricot Khanom Thai
description: A pungent and crisp Thai dish featuring apricot, this khanom thai is a show-off dessert that is nut-free-friendly, making it perfect for those with allergies. The katsuramuki-cut apricot adds a beautiful touch to this traditional Thai dessert.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Peel the apricots using a katsuramuki-cut technique to create a beautiful spiral design.
In a large mixing bowl, whisk together the rice flour, tapioca starch, and salt.
Add the melted butter, eggs, palm sugar, and coconut milk to the dry ingredients and mix until a smooth batter forms.
Add the water to the batter and mix until well combined.
Pour the batter into a 9-inch round cake pan and arrange the apricot slices on top in a spiral pattern.
Bake the khanom thai for 35 minutes or until the edges are golden brown and the center is set.
Remove the khanom thai from the oven and let it cool in the pan for 10 minutes.
Transfer the khanom thai to a wire rack to cool completely.
Serve the khanom thai warm or at room temperature.
